publication_scope: Curated results and source hash receipts. Raw operational records remain local; this download is not a full reproduction archive.

direct_cm_cse.case: One admitted 74181 ALU case, 14 inputs and four outputs
direct_cm_cse.metric: Fully charged supervisor process wall time; warmups and validation excluded
direct_cm_cse.qualification: Approved telemetry-only successor after the original validation stopped on unavailable optional process I/O. Same oracle, arms and paired schedule; not a newly untouched holdout or unamended original run. Optional I/O remains unavailable. Admission covers accessible recorded history; 225 inaccessible historical paths remain a limitation. Both intervals cross 1: no confirmed improvement, inferiority or equivalence.

bucket_cudd.case: counting-exact-0a59550d01e7faaf; 24 variables, 63 clauses; exact unrestricted count 70
bucket_cudd.metric: Fully charged supervisor process wall time; warmups excluded
bucket_cudd.qualification: Prepared deadline corrected from 90 to 60 seconds after cold execution, before any prepared cell began. Six unstarted prepared cells ran in a second service; cold cells were not rerun. Bucket is an exact-count backend, and this result does not establish a CM IR advantage. CUDD answered prepared queries faster after its longer setup. No broad, projected-count or RunPod confirmation claim.

exploratory.qualification: Two regression inputs: onehot BLIF and s27 CNF. No writable delegated cgroup child, so the strict kernel memory requirement was unmet. Supervisor wall had an approximately 125 ms common floor. Worker phases are diagnostics: CM IR was slower than CSE; Bucket preparation was faster than CUDD, while CUDD prepared queries were faster. Owned Pod deletion and empty inventories were recorded; actual billing was not queried.
